data.name: Farnaz
data.gender_notes: Farnaz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Persian word 'far', meaning 'to produce' and 'naz', meaning 'jasmine'. This name signifies the gentle and beautiful nature of the jasmine flower. The name Farnaz carries the meaning “Gentle, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Farnaz usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the beauty and gentleness of nature, and the divine feminine energy.
data.etymology: Farnaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farnaz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

In Islamic tradition, Farnaz is a name that is associated with positive qualities such as kindness, generosity, and compassion. It is a name that is highly regarded in Muslim cultures around the world and is often given to girls born into Muslim families.
